mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM reservation
AND equipment_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{equipmentName}, '%')
AND user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM reservation WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND ( (start_time <= #{endTime} AND end_time >= #{startTime}) OR (start_time >= #{startTime} AND start_time < #{endTime}) OR (end_time > #{startTime} AND end_time <= #{endTime}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (equipment_id, user_id, user_name, equipment_name, start_time, end_time, purpose, status, create_time) VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{equipmentName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{purpose}, #{status}, NOW())
